title: should
summary: **should** — «следует, стоит, лучше бы»: совет и мнение о том, что хорошо и правильно делать.
ru:
## Когда используем should
**should + глагол** — когда мы считаем, что делать что-то **хорошо и правильно** (совет, мнение).
> You should drink more water. — Тебе стоит пить больше воды.
> Tom should go to bed earlier. — Тому следует ложиться раньше.
> It's a great book. You should read it. — Отличная книга. Тебе стоит её прочитать.

## Как строится
- форма одна для всех лиц: *he should* (не ~~he shoulds~~)
- после should — глагол без **to**: ~~you should to go~~ → you should go
- отрицание: **shouldn't** (should not) — «не стоит»
> You shouldn't eat so much sugar. — Тебе не стоит есть так много сахара.

## I think ... should
Часто совет смягчают: **I think ... should**.
> I think you should call her. — Думаю, тебе стоит ей позвонить.
> I don't think you should work so late. — Не думаю, что тебе стоит работать так поздно.
Обратите внимание: русское «не думаю, что стоит» → **I don't think ... should** (а не ~~I think ... shouldn't~~).

## Вопросы
> Should I buy this jacket? — Мне купить эту куртку?
> What should we do? — Что нам делать?
> Do you think I should wait? — Как думаешь, мне подождать?

## should и must
**must** сильнее: «обязательно, надо». **should** мягче: «стоит, было бы хорошо».
> You should see a doctor. — Тебе стоит сходить к врачу. (совет)
> You must see a doctor. — Тебе нужно к врачу. (очень серьёзно)

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~You should to rest.~~ → You should rest.
- ~~He shoulds study.~~ → He should study.
- ~~Do I should go?~~ → **Should** I go?
- ~~I think he shouldn't to go.~~ → I don't think he **should** go.
en:
## When do we use should?
We use **should + verb** to say that something is a good thing to do or the right thing to do. We give advice or an opinion.
> You should drink more water.
> Tom should go to bed earlier.
> It's a great book. You should read it.

## How to make it
- the form is the same for all persons: *he should* (not ~~he shoulds~~)
- no **to** after should
- negative: **shouldn't** (should not)
> You shouldn't eat so much sugar.

## I think ... should
> I think you should call her.
> I don't think you should work so late.
We say **I don't think ... should**, not ~~I think ... shouldn't~~.

## Questions
> Should I buy this jacket?
> What should we do?
> Do you think I should wait?

## should and must
**must** is stronger. **should** is softer.
> You should see a doctor. (advice)
> You must see a doctor. (very serious)

## Common mistakes
- ~~You should to rest.~~ → You should rest.
- ~~He shoulds study.~~ → He should study.
- ~~Do I should go?~~ → **Should** I go?
structure:
## Утверждение, отрицание, вопрос
| | Форма | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| Утверждение | I / you / he / she / we / they **should** + глагол | You should rest. |
| Отрицание | **shouldn't** (should not) + глагол | He shouldn't worry. |
| Вопрос | **Should** + подлежащее + глагол? | Should I stay? |
| Краткий ответ | Yes, you should. / No, you shouldn't. | |

## Формула
> Подлежащее + **should / shouldn't** + глагол без to
> **I think** + подлежащее + **should** ...
> **I don't think** + подлежащее + **should** ...
> **Do you think** + подлежащее + **should** ...?

## Запомните
- нет -s, нет to;
- совет: **should**; сильная необходимость: **must**;
- вопросы: **What should I do?** / **Should we go?**

items.text: You look tired. You {{should}} go to bed early.
Emma has a cough. She {{shouldn't|should not}} go out without a coat.
You {{should}} visit the new museum. It's great.
You {{shouldn't|should not}} watch TV all day. It's bad for your eyes.
I {{should}} study more if I want to pass the test.
I think you {{should}} talk to your teacher.
I {{don't}} think he should leave so early.
Do you think I {{should}} buy this phone?
I don't think we {{should}} stay here. It's very late.
I think Paul {{should}} take a holiday. He works too much.
I {{don't}} think you should eat so many sweets.

items.q: You ___ see a dentist. Your tooth hurts.
My sister ___ eat so much chocolate.
I ___ you should wait. It's too early.
He has a test tomorrow. He ___ study tonight.
Tom is always tired. He sleeps 4 hours a night.

items.q: Lena has a headache. She works at the computer all day.
options: She should to take a break.
She not should take a break.
You shouldn't eat so much cake.
items.why: Смысл: меньше торта → **shouldn't eat so much**.

answers: He should go to the dentist.
Mike should go to the dentist.

items.prompt: Kate eats too much fast food. (eat / so much)
answers: She shouldn't eat so much fast food.
Kate shouldn't eat so much fast food.

items.prompt: We are late for the lesson. (hurry)
I think your bag is too heavy. (carry / so many books)
answers: You shouldn't carry so many books.
I think you shouldn't carry so many books.

items.prompt: Ему не стоит так много работать.
answers: He should not work so much.
He should not work so hard.

items.prompt: Не думаю, что нам стоит идти.
answers: I don't think we should go.
I do not think we should go.

exercises.title: Напишите о себе
exercises.instruction: Ответьте полными предложениями. Проверьте по образцу.

items.prompt: One thing you should do more often
One thing you shouldn't do so much
items.sample: I shouldn't use my phone so much.

items.prompt: Advice for a friend who can't sleep
items.sample: You should go to bed earlier and shouldn't drink coffee in the evening.

items.prompt: Advice for a tourist in your city
items.sample: You should visit the old town. You shouldn't miss the museum.

items.prompt: Something you think people should do
items.sample: I think people should be kind to each other.
